note: Which structure draws each model channel or pump, and the sourced single-channel conductance or turnover used to turn the solver's conductance or pump rate into counts. Sources and verdicts: docs/nanoscope.md.

naleak.label: ENaC (Na channel)
naleak.source: Ishikawa 1998, rat alpha-beta-gamma ENaC, Na+, 20-23 C (V)

kv3p4.label: Kv3.4 (voltage-gated K)
kv3p4.source: Fernandez 2003, Kv3.1 + Kv3.4 co-expressed, 32-38 pS; no value for homomeric Kv3.4 (P)

pump.label: Na/K-ATPase
pump.source: Friedrich 1996, about 200 per s at 36 C, saturating substrates (V)

gap_junction.label: Cx43 hemichannel
gap_junction.source: Bukauskas & Peracchia 1997, main state about 120 pS (V)
